rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese cardinal number for 19, including in years such as 1969.

example.english: I was nineteen when I travelled alone for the first time.
example.traditional: 我十九歲嗰年，第一次自己去旅行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sap6 gau2 seoi3 go2 nin4 dai6 jat1 ci3 zi6 gei2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
